mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are currently clear near Badger Ridge Middle School with the Full Moon visible. The temperature is 59 degrees, and we are expecting an overnight low of 53 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has announced that a segment of Highway M near the upcoming Aldi development will be closed for final road improvements from October 5 through October 7. Traffic will be detoured to Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street, so please allow for extra travel time.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with live music today at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, or head out to trivia nights starting Tuesday at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly look at noteworthy calls, on September 5, an officer located multiple vehicles with cheese slices placed on their windshields throughout several streets in the city, an incident attributed to a viral social media prank.
Today's flavor of the day was Turtle, but as we are now closed for the night, we look forward to serving you tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM with our Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor.
